tagline: 奥林巴斯数码单反相机，2009 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2009年推出的数码单反相机。配备Four Thirds。快门速度focal-plane shutter。

specs.传感器: Live MOS Four Thirds 17.3 mm × 13.0 mm (2× crop factor)
specs.取景器: Eye-Level TTL Optical Pentamirror with 96% coverage and 0.96× magnification
specs.闪光灯: Standard 4/3 flash hot shoe compatible with 4/3 system flashes, automatic built-in pop-up, 13 m ISO 100 guide number, 27 mm (equivalent in 135 format) lens focal length coverage;
specs.屏幕: Vari-Angle 2.7 HyperCrystal III TFT LCD with 230,000 pixels
specs.存储: CompactFlash Type I/II (UDMA), Microdrive, xD-Picture Card
